description: The plot illustrates MRR@10 performance as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S), comparing four DPR-related settings. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S).” and uses a linear scale with integer values from 1 to 10, shown at regular tick intervals of 2 (2, 4, 6, 8, 10). The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with regularly spaced tick marks every 0.5. A black solid horizontal line (“DPR w/o query”) stays constant across all S at approximately 34.25. A red line with circular markers (“DPR w/ corpus expansion”) increases from about 35.15 at S=1 to about 35.55 at S=2, then continues with small upward steps to around 35.78 by S=7, dips slightly near S=8 (~35.74), rises again around S=9 (~35.79), and ends near 35.78 at S=10. A green line with upward triangle markers (“DPR w/ document expansion”) remains nearly flat, starting around 34.78 at S=1, staying close to 34.85–34.93 through S=7 (with a local high near S=6 at ~34.93), and ending around 34.84 at S=10. A blue line with star markers (legend entry not visible) fluctuates around the mid–34s, starting near 34.75 at S=1, reaching about 35.00 at S=2, dropping to about 34.70 at S=3, rising again to about 35.00 at S=5, then trending downward with small oscillations to about 34.38 by S=10.
